description: Full-stack .NET developer who turns sprawling enterprise systems into software people actually enjoy using—Blazor by trade, detail-obsessed by nature.
detailOrQuote: 🛠️ Currently leading the full-stack build of an ERP system for a global nonprofit—built a secure data-masking pipeline for safe dev access, synced Salesforce and ERP records, and shipped 50 custom reports relied on by 500+ staff. 🎨 Before that, led UI/UX design and development across four applications with Figma, Blazor, Syncfusion, and SQL Server.
